def latest():
    with open(OUT/'latest.pkl','rb') as f:return pickle.load(f)
def state(res=None):
    res=res or latest();return dict(zip(res.meta['proprio']['layout'],res.meta['proprio']['now']))
def joints(res=None):
    s=state(res)
    return np.array([0.,0.,0.]+[s[f'torso_joint{i}'] for i in range(1,5)]+[s[f'left_arm_joint{i}'] for i in range(1,8)]+[.07,.07]+[s[f'right_arm_joint{i}'] for i in range(1,8)]+[.07,.07])
def pixel(u,v,cam=0):
    o=latest();c=list(o.last)[cam];d=o.last_depth[c][v,u]
    K=np.array(o.meta['cameras'][c]['intrinsic_cv']);E=np.array(o.meta['cameras'][c]['extrinsic_cv'])
    xyz=E[:,:3].T@(np.linalg.inv(K)@np.array([u,v,1])*d-E[:,3])
    print('PIXEL',u,v,'depth',d,'world',xyz);return xyz

def report(res,tag):
    res.save(str(OUT/tag))
    with open(OUT/'latest.pkl','wb') as f:pickle.dump(res,f)
    for i,(cam,img) in enumerate(res.last.items()):Image.fromarray(img).resize((672,672)).save(OUT/f'view{i}.png')
    print({k:res.meta.get(k) for k in ['done','reason','calls','control_steps','time_left_s','plan','clipped']},flush=True)
    print('BASE',res.group('base_pose',now=True),'EEF',res.group('eef_pose',now=True),'GRIP',res.group('gripper_opening',now=True),flush=True)

def act(a,dt=1/30,tag='move'):
    a=np.array(a);a=a[None] if a.ndim==1 else a
    with open(OUT/'actions.jsonl','a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'type':'joint_position','actions':a.tolist(),'dt':dt,'tag':tag})+'\n')
    res=r.submit('joint_position',a,dt=dt,depth=True);report(res,f'{res.meta["calls"]:04d}_{tag}');return res

def drive(x=0,y=0,yaw=0,n=60,grips=(.07,.07)):
    a=joints();a[14:16]=grips[0];a[23:25]=grips[1];a[:3]=[x/n,y/n,yaw/n]
    arr=np.tile(a,(n+15,1));arr[n:,:3]=0
    return act(arr,tag='drive')

def move_ik(pos,side='left',quat=None,grips=(.07,.07),seconds=3):
    o=latest();s=state(o);q=[s[k] for k in spec['kinematics']['joint_names']]
    if quat is None:quat=o.group('eef_pose',now=True)[3:7] if side=='left' else o.group('eef_pose',now=True)[10:14]
    ik=r.ik({side+'_eef_link':list(pos)+list(quat)},seed=q,base_pose=o.group('base_pose',now=True).tolist())
    print('IK',ik,flush=True)
    if not ik['ok']:return
    a=joints();a[14:16]=grips[0];a[23:25]=grips[1];b=a.copy();q=ik['q'];b[3:14]=q[:11];b[16:23]=q[11:]
    arr=np.linspace(a,b,int(seconds*30));arr=np.vstack([arr,np.tile(b,(20,1))]);return act(arr,tag='ik')
PY

def world_drive(dx,dy,n=90,grips=(.07,.07)):
    from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
    R=Rotation.from_quat(latest().group('base_pose',now=True)[3:]).as_matrix()
    local=np.linalg.solve(R[:2,:2],np.array([dx,dy]));print('local',local,flush=True)
    return drive(x=local[0],y=local[1],n=n,grips=grips)

    ik=r.ik(targets,seed=q,base_pose=o.group('base_pose',now=True).tolist());print('IK',ik,flush=True)
    if not ik['ok']:return
    a=joints();a[14:16]=grips[0];a[23:25]=grips[1];b=a.copy();q=ik['q'];b[3:14]=q[:11];b[16:23]=q[11:]
    return act(np.vstack([np.linspace(a,b,int(seconds*30)),np.tile(b,(60,1))]),tag='multi_ik')
